description: Department of Census and Statistics - The National Consumer Price Index computed for the month of March, 2018 was122.8
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for March 2018, published by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial). This is a statistical announcement that falls under general administrative matters, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
